coordinates: KineFX imported world metres; Y-up; signed forward uses previous-head to tip-head normalized direction.
axis_scope: KineFX imported transform row axes; these do not independently certify native UE BoneForwardAxis because FBX import may convert bone axes.

leg_weighted_points.selection: Any individual anatomical leg influence > 0.01 (same 226-point source cohort).

dummy_reach_measurement.interpretation: Geometric overhang only. A global dummy length near the largest p95/max covers most/all dominant skin reach if native UE axis is proven; it is not a validated physics tune. Per-tip reach is asymmetric.
